title: Classics, One Hand Each
subtitle: Piano pieces by the masters shared between two players
blurb: Each player takes one hand of the original: not a note is changed. Bach minuets, Schumann's Album for the Young, Burgmüller studies, Satie's Gymnopédies and more.
